content:
Fox News’ Harold Ford Jr. on Thursday slammed Donald Trump over his friendly approach to Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping, calling him “the most pro-communist American president in my lifetime.”

During a discussion on “The Five” about Trump’s trilateral meeting with the two leaders in China, the former Democratic congressman from Tennessee said he was “disgusted” to hear Trump greet Putin as his friend.

“Here is a guy who is an invader, who is waging a war, costing American treasure, costing weapons, costing us to deplete, and costing lives of Ukrainians,” Ford said of Putin.

Ford argued that Putin was stringing Trump along, pointing out that “nothing happened” after their summit in Alaska last year.

“President Trump, who I like as a person and as a friend. This is the most pro-communist American president in my lifetime. I grew up in a time when Republicans were anti-communist. I grew up in a time when Republicans attacked, rightly so, Democrats who they thought were friendly to communists.”

Ford questioned what the United States had gained from either leader before delivering a blunt message to Trump: “Mr. President, they’re both tapping you along.”
